To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that
the proposed hardware solutions for new sensors can be successfully used in WSN.
the presented ANN chip is the first prototype of an ANN realized in CMOS technology that can be used as an intelligent sensor in WSN.
we have designed a prototype chip in CMOS 130 nm technology with components of the ANNs.
In summary, our research is concerned with
developing an intelligent sensor with the ability to learn and to make decisions.
the realization of a miniature, low-power ANN in CMOS technology for the purpose of intelligent sensors used in wireless sensor network applications.
the realization of components of the ANN in the CMOS technology.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
the proposed design of a specialized chip with the ANN is a very good solution for the realization of intelligent sensors in the WSN.
a novel approach to the realization of intelligent sensors has been presented.
the presented ANN components have been realized in the CMOS technology and can be used in the design of intelligent sensors for WSN.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
we designed a specialized chip for the ANN with a programmable multi-phased clock generator and an adaptation mechanism.
